headline: H100 SXM index rises +7% over 7 days to $4.62 while other GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM was the only mover at +7% over 7 days, with a $4.62 market index across 12 providers and Vast.ai cheapest at $2.20.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, though only 4 providers list it and its neocloud median is $2.92 versus $6.75 at hyperscalers.
Hyperscaler premiums are widest on H100 SXM at +151% ($10.68 vs $4.25 neocloud) and narrowest on B200 at +77% ($14.12 vs $7.99).
B200 holds at an $8.50 index with +0% change, while RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $5.98 and costs $3.78 per PFLOP-hour.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a $2.70 index, with marketplace pricing at $1.36.
watch: Whether H100 SXM's +7% move holds or spreads to H200, which is flat at a $5.40 index.
